All 7 tests pass cleanly.

## Summary

Created `gson/src/test/java/com/google/gson/internal/bind/JsonAdapterAnnotationTypeAdapterFactoryAgentTest.java`, matching the project's JUnit 3 (`extends TestCase`) style used by neighboring tests like `JsonTreeWriterTest`.

Tests cover the public API (constructor + `create(Gson, TypeToken)`):

1. **`testCreateReturnsNullWhenTypeIsNotAnnotated`** — unannotated class → `null`.
2. **`testCreateReturnsAdapterFromAnnotatedTypeAdapterClass`** — `@JsonAdapter` pointing at a `TypeAdapter` subclass produces a working adapter (asserts actual serialized/deserialized values).
3. **`testCreatedAdapterIsNullSafe`** — verifies the factory wraps the adapter with `nullSafe()` (the declared adapter itself would NPE on null; the wrapped one handles it via `nullValue()`/short-circuit read).
4. **`testCreateInvokesAnnotatedTypeAdapterFactory`** — `@JsonAdapter` pointing at a `TypeAdapterFactory` correctly delegates and gets nullSafe-wrapped.
5. **`testCreateReturnsNullWhenFactoryReturnsNullAdapter`** — boundary case where the referenced factory itself returns `null`.
6. **`testCreateThrowsForInvalidAnnotationValue`** — error case: annotation value is neither `TypeAdapter` nor `TypeAdapterFactory` → `IllegalArgumentException` with the exact expected message.
7. **`testCreateIsIndependentPerInvocation`** — each `create()` call constructs a fresh, independently usable adapter instance (`assertNotSame` + behavioral check).

Verified via:
- `defects4j compile` → OK
- `java -cp "$(defects4j export -p cp.test)" org.junit.runner.JUnitCore com.google.gson.internal.bind.JsonAdapterAnnotationTypeAdapterFactoryAgentTest` → `OK (7 tests)`

No files other than this new test class were created or modified.
